name: Hardwood floor refinishing
summary: Sand-and-finish or screen-and-recoat jobs priced from field square feet, stair treads, closets and coats.

items.label: Full sand and 3 coats, field
items.source: Full sand 8 h per 100 sq ft, factor 1 (index.html); 3 coats, 450 sq ft/gal/coat, $85/gal rounded up to 6 gal over 848 sq ft finish area, plus $18 per 100 sq ft supplies (index.html)

items.label: Stair treads
items.source: 0.4 h per tread (index.html); 4 sq ft finish per tread (STAIR_SQ_FT_PER_TREAD) at the same finish+supplies rate

items.label: Closets
items.source: 1 h per closet (index.html); specialist adds no closet material

specialistModels: Rounds finish and stain to whole gallons by coats and coverage, switches screen-and-recoat versus full sand, and adds stain and colour-change coat hours.
